Description: Four separate native patch downloads in installation order. Reference archive hashes identify the locally verified files; the VR installer validates the installed DLL profile separately.

Packages.Name: Community Patch 1.75.14
Packages.Installation: Run the installer after installing Gothic 3 and starting the flat game once.

Packages.Name: Update Pack 1.04.11
Packages.Installation: Run this EXE after Community Patch 1.75.14, before applying the Public Beta archive.

Packages.Name: Update Pack 1.05.10 Public Beta
Packages.Installation: Extract the entire ZIP over an existing Update Pack 1.04.11 installation, replacing its supplied files.

Packages.Name: Parallel Universe Patch 1.1.1
Packages.Installation: Run after the native updates. Follow the patch's included readme.
